newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket - Queensland restrict Tasmania to 14 for one.
newsitem.headline: Cricket - Queensland restrict Tasmania to 14 for one.

text.p: Swing bowler Adam Dale took his maiden first class wicket on Wednesday as Queensland restricted Tasmania to 14 for one on a rain-shortened opening day of the first match of the new Sheffield Shield season.
Persistent rain throughout the day meant only 30 minutes of play were possible, with more showers forecast for Thursday.
The entire morning session was washed out and Queensland captain Matthew Hayden had no hesitation in asking Tasmania to bat on a green wicket after he won the toss.
Hayden's bowlers made the most of the limited time available to them, with Dale and Andrew Bichel having brief but lively spells.
Dale almost had Tasmania opener Jamie Cox caught with his first ball, Cox prodding forward with a defensive stroke and a diving Trevor Barsby almost holding the catch at short leg.
Three balls later Dale caught the outside edge of Cox's bat to have him caught by Jimmy Maher at third slip.
Dale finished with 1-1 from 3.3 overs in the 7.3 overs of play possible before washed out the rest of the day's play.
